items.title: Glasses microphone
items.detail: Glasses voice uses the left temple’s microphone from any tab. If the left temple is disconnected, connect it before recording.

items.title: Laptop Porter in the sidebar
items.detail: When the Laptop is serving as Porter’s fallback, open its conversation directly from the sidebar. The title-bar icons are centered.

items.title: Glasses alignment
items.detail: HUD text uses the glasses font widths for centering. Use Alignment check in the Glasses tab to compare the center and depth layers on both lenses.

limits: Bluetooth pairing and in-app transcription still need hardware verification.
